subject: Priya Sharma — day-of: alternative interview options and confirmation
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@talentops.co>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 07:12:00 -0800
Subject: Priya Sharma — interview today (AM) — urgent alternate plan

Team,

Heads up — Sara just pinged that Priya woke up with a fever and a positive rapid result. She's not comfortable doing onsite or video right now but is still interested in proceeding if we can offer an alternative. Today's original schedule: 10:30–12:00 onsite (coding + system design).

Options I see (ranked by minimal disruption):
- Offer a 30‑min focused phone screen at 10:45 PT (no whiteboard) — covers core API/architecture questions so we don't lose momentum.
- Provide a condensed take‑home coding exercise with 48‑hour turnaround; interviewers can review asynchronously and debrief later.
- Reschedule full onsite for next week (we'll lose momentum but keep the loop intact).

Attachments: Priya's latest resume (attached).

Quick asks: can Markus cover a short API/design portion at 10:45 if we pivot to phone? Marissa, if we go take‑home, can you prepare the shortened prompt and upload to Drive? Grace, do you want to be on the 30‑min call or hold for full onsite reschedule?

I can send the candidate a single email with the options and a suggested 10:45 phone slot if team is comfortable.

—Irene

--
Irene Choi
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 07:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Priya Sharma — interview today (AM) — urgent alternate plan

+1 on the 30‑min phone at 10:45.
I can take the take‑home if we need it, but given Priya has already completed a take‑home in the past role, a focused phone will get us the signals we need (API design, tradeoffs).

Markus — is 10:45 workable for you? I'll pull a short prompt and a feedback template and share the Drive link.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Recruiter (Engineering Hiring)
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@gmail.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@talentops.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 07:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Priya — today

Priya — thanks for the update and I hope you feel better soon. We have a couple of options if you're comfortable: 1) a short 30‑minute phone screen today at 10:45 AM PT (we'll skip whiteboarding, just an architectural + API discussion), or 2) a condensed take‑home assignment we can give you with 48 hours to return. If neither works, we can reschedule the onsite.

If 10:45 works, we'll call the mobile number you provided on your application unless you prefer another number — let me know. If you prefer the take‑home, we'll send it over within an hour.

Attached: resume we have on file (for quick reference).

Best,
Irene
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@gmail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@talentops.co>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Priya — today

Hi Irene — thanks for checking in. I tested positive but I'm feeling OK and can do a 30‑minute phone at 10:45 PT. Please call my cell: +1 (415) 555‑0192.

I won't be able to do whiteboard or screen share, so the phone option is best. I've attached an up‑to‑date code archive and my resume in case that helps.

—Priya

Attachments: priya_code_snippet.zip, priya_sharma_resume.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Priya Sharma — day-of: alternative interview options and confirmation

Called at 10:45 — Priya was on and we had a solid 28‑minute call. High‑level notes:
- Strong API design intuition, clear on rate limiting and cache strategies.
- Asked good clarifying Qs about tradeoffs; minimal handwaving.
- No chance to see code live, but the snippet she attached looks clean.

Recommendation: advance to a short asynchronous take‑home (focused endpoint implementation, ~4–6 hrs expected) to validate coding. If she returns that, let's schedule the full systems interview next week — prefer Tue/Wed.

I've uploaded quick feedback to the hiring doc (link below). Can Marissa send the take‑home prompt and timeline? If Priya completes, I'd slot a full panel on Tue 19 Jan 10–12.

Markus

Link (internal): https://docs.google.com/document/d/feedback-priya
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@gmail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps — take‑home and tentative panel slot

Thanks Markus — good call. Priya, we're going to send a short take‑home that focuses on implementing a single endpoint (we expect ~4 hours of work). Marissa will share the prompt and a Drive link; you'll have 48 hours from sending to return. If you complete it, our preferred follow‑up panel is Tue 19 Jan 10:00–12:00 PT (tentative — we'll confirm after we see the take‑home).

Marissa — when you send the prompt, cc Sara (talentops) so Priya has the recruiter buffer. Priya — feel free to flag if the timeline is tight; we can adjust.

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
